name: waffle-view
description: A pane showing this repo's resolved wafflestack state — behavioral keys, run files, locks, drift, sliced to what the last `/skill` cares about (the agent roster with live per-agent status, and what the team is working on, during `/standup`) — read through `wafflestack state --json`, with an "Open in <editor>" button (`waffleView.editor`, default Cursor).
